a.style: font-family:'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif

text.tspan: Estimate of the effective reproduction rate (R) of COVID-19, 30 to 1075
The reproduction rate represents the average number of new infections caused by a single infected individual. If
the rate is greater than 1, the infection is able to spread in the population. If it is below 1, the number of cases
occurring in the population will gradually decrease to zero.
Data source: Arroyo-Marioli F, Bullano F, Kucinskas S, Rondón-Moreno C (2023)
